Responsibility: Reads keystrokes in raw mode. Handles arrow keys (↑↓←→), backspace, tab completion, and line editing. Returns a complete string on Enter.
Splits raw input into `Token` objects. Tracks quote state (`'...'` vs `"..."`) and handles escape sequences (`\"`, `\'`, `\$`).
Substitutes `$VAR`, `$?`, `$$`, and environment variables. Skips tokens marked as single-quoted.
Uses POSIX `glob()` to expand `*`, `?`, and `~` patterns. One token can become many tokens.
Dispatches builtins (`cd`, `pwd`) in the parent process. Forks and `execvp`s external commands. Handles pipes and redirections.
Global `last_exit_status` shared between parser and executor for `$?` expansion.
